newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israelis soldiers kill Palestinian, wound three.
newsitem.headline: Israelis soldiers kill Palestinian, wound three.

text.p: Israelis soldiers killed a Palestinian and wounded three others in a clash in a West Bank village near Jerusalem on Tuesday, the army said.
An aide to Palestinian President Yasser Arafat said the shooting was a crime and a violation of human rights.
An army spokesman said the soldiers were attacked by Palestinian residents of the Hizmeh village north of Jerusalem during operational activity.
"The force responded with fire killing one Palestinian, wounding one moderately to severely and wounding two others lightly," the spokesman said.
He said the army was in contact with Palestinian police about the incident.

Security sources said the soldiers were part of an undercover unit whose members patrol the West Bank in civilian clothes, often dressed to look like Palestinians. They said the soldiers were attacked by dozens of residents when they tried to arrest a stone-thrower.
Channel Two television identified the dead Palestinian as Abdel-Aziz Abu Hilu, 56.
"This is a crime that has been carried out by the secret units which continue to function as if there are no agreements or political negotiations," said Arafat's aide, Ahmed Tibi.
Israel handed over parts of the West Bank to Palestinian rule under peace deals signed since 1993 but Israeli soldiers still patrol other areas of the West Bank.
Palestinians said under the agreements the Palestinian Authority was responsible for civil affairs and public order in Hizmeh and Israelis were responsible for security.
The prime minister's office issued a statement saying Benjamin Netanyahu had been briefed about the incident.
Netanyuahu was expected on Wednesday to approve construction of a new Jewish neighbourhood in Arab East Jerusalem, a decision that Palestinians have warned could trigger violence.
